sentences.text: An application seeking regular bail having been rejected by the High Court vide impugned order dated 20.02.2025, the appellant has preferred the instant appeal.
By order dated 20.05.2025, this Court issued notice to the respondents.
Thereafter, vide order dated 08.08.2025, this Court directed the Trial Court to conclude the recording of the evidence of PW-1 as well as of the victim.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant in support of the appeal and learned standing counsel for the respondent-State and perused the material on record.

Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the allegations against the appellant herein are vexatious and false inasmuch as there was a consensual relationship between the appellant and the so-called victim, who has also now testified before the Court as PW2; that the appellant has been in jail since 23.07.2024 and that the relief of bail may be granted to him by setting aside the impugned order subject to the terms and conditions to be imposed.
Learned counsel for the appellant also submitted that since only a few more witnesses have to be examined, the appellant would cooperate with the trial.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned standing counsel for the first respondent-State contended that there is no merit in this appeal and if a time frame is fixed, the Special Court would conclude the trial within the said time frame and hence, the appeal may be dismissed.
Considering the facts on record, in our view, the case for bail is made out.

We, therefore, allow this appeal and direct as under:
The appellant shall be produced before the concerned Trial Court as early as possible and the Trial Court shall release him on bail, subject to such conditions as it may deem appropriate to impose to ensure his presence in the proceedings arising out of Case Crime No. 146/2024 dated 20.07.2024 mentioned above.
It is directed that the appellant shall extend complete cooperation in the trial of the instant case without seeking frivolous adjournments.
The appellant shall not misuse his liberty and shall not in any way influence the witnesses or tamper with the material on record.
The appellant shall not in any way make an attempt to contact the victim.
Any infraction of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail granted to the appellant.
With the aforesaid directions, the criminal appeal is allowed.
